messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — Rdw-infer-prod: tokenization worker OOM, auto-failover triggered. Incident ticket #INC-20260312 created. Short summary: 2026-03-12 02:14 UTC → 02:47 UTC. Impact: ~4% API 5xx, ~350 requests affected, a brief latency spike for embeddings. Paging cleared at 02:47 UTC.

Mike (oncall): I rolled a hotfix and scaled down the faulty job. Reverted the recent KV cache size tweak that grew memory unexpectedly. Deploy: `deploy/2026-03-12-om-fix`.

Jess (SRE): I'll own the RCA and timeline. Adding initial logs to the incident doc, quick repro snippet: ```kubectl logs tok-worker-3 | grep -i oom
...OOMKilled at 02:17:43 UTC
``` Will add full traces to the doc.

Linda - CS: Need a customer-facing blurb for statuspage + an email for the impacted customers. Prefer 1-paragraph summary + an appendix with technical details.

Amy (C-Success): I can send targeted emails to customers who opened tickets. Need the exact incident window and an approved message. Legal review required for full RCA share.

Wanda (PM): Proposing a postmortem on Thurs 2026-03-14 16:00 UTC. Jess, can you run the RCA session? We should capture timeline, root cause, action items, and assign owners.

Jess (SRE): Yes, I'll run the RCA. Tentative owners: RCA write-up & timeline (Jess), remediation implementation (Mike), alert tuning & synthetic tests (SRE team), customer comms draft (Linda/Amy).

Mike (oncall): Action list I'm creating now:
1) Revert KV size change — done (PR #456).
2) Implement mem-cap fallback in runtime — INF-789 (owner: Mike) — in progress.
3) Add synthetic test to detect KV growth patterns — INF-790 (owner: eng-runtime) — planned.
I'll attach the JIRA links to the incident doc.

Linda - CS: Draft statuspage copy (please review):
```
Status: Degraded between 02:14–02:47 UTC.
Summary: A worker process experienced an out-of-memory condition after a configuration change, causing a subset of requests to fail with 5xx responses.
Resolution: We reverted the configuration change and rolled a hotfix; service restored at 02:47 UTC.
Next steps: We will publish a postmortem and remediation timeline once the RCA completes.
```

Amy (C-Success): Approved pending legal: add a line for customers who saw errors: "If you experienced persistent failures please contact support and we will prioritize a review."

Wanda (PM): Postmortem agenda: 1) exact timeline, 2) root cause, 3) corrective actions & owners, 4) prevention plan, 5) QA/testing, 6) comms. Please dump evidence into the incident doc: https://internal/docs/incidents/1965432100

Jess (SRE): Initial finding: a memory-accounting edge-case in the runtime's cache eviction path caused KV entries to not be evicted for certain tokenization patterns. Repro steps and heap dumps are in the doc. I'll post a full draft RCA by EOW.

Mike (oncall): Created tickets: INF-789 (mem cap fallback) due 2026-03-19, INF-790 (synthetic KV growth test) due 2026-03-26. Links in the incident tracker.

Linda - CS: I'll publish the statuspage now and save the detailed appendix to the incident doc. Amy, once legal signs off I'll send the customer emails and coordinate the enterprise follow-up calls. Draft will be in #statuspage-drafts.

Amy (C-Success): Scheduling: follow-up call with affected enterprise tenants on Tue 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Can Mike & Jess join for technical Q&A?

Mike (oncall): I can join.

Jess (SRE): I'll join.

ops-bot: Follow-up checklist — postmortem scheduled, RCA owner assigned, INF tickets created, statuspage posted, customer emails pending legal approval. Incident link: https://internal/incident-tracker/INC-20260312

Mike (oncall): I'll update the runbook with new thresholds and add the fallback config to the default deploy template (PR forthcoming).

Linda - CS: tagging for visibility @here — please react with :thumbsup: when you've reviewed the customer message.

Jess (SRE): :thumbsup: 

Amy (C-Success): :thumbsup: 

Wanda (PM): Closing immediate ops loop. I'll compile the action-item list, add owners/due dates, and send a calendar invite for a short sync tomorrow to review readiness for the customer calls.
